title: Libre3 Webfollower: beonlabs community script for Web Follower is not available
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3125
Originally posted by **pkmzl** October 10, 2023 Hi, the source of the custom script https://community-script.beonlabs.net returns a file with text "service ceased". So that xDrip doesn't get data from Libre 3 anymore. How could the problem be solved?
The Libre3 Webfollower stopped getting data at some point. A fresh installation of xDrip didn't help. If the necessary script is missing, it would also explain the missing sugar data. Please fix the script service if possible, the webfollower is awesome :)

comments.body:
Can you ask in the following discussion for advice?
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3230

And please don't create an issue without being asked.  Thanks
